acceptance_evidence: unittest discover green; validate_shiki green; a real claude -p reviewer envelope parses to a valid verdict; CCA complete; MergeGate green.
completion_conditions: REVIEWER_ADAPTER passes --output-format json and parse_code_review_verdict reads the result envelope's structured_output field (subtype-gated, fail-closed), verified against real reviewer output.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests is green and python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py passes.
non_goals: No change to the reviewer's read-only confinement contract (--tools allowlist, --strict-mcp-config, --setting-sources, --permission-mode dontAsk unchanged).
No product source change outside the reviewer adapter/parser and its tests.
outcome: The loop's pre-PR code-review gate reliably parses a structured verdict from the real headless claude -p reviewer (via --output-format json + structured_output), so a low-risk task self-drives past the gate instead of failing closed on unparseable prose.
